north.evidence: Rao 1962-63 Fig. 8 (PDF page 58): a compass wheel crossed by an arrow from upper right to lower left, at the upper right of the plan; the thicker, arrowhead-like end is at the lower left and was taken as the tip (a 180 degree reversal would not change theta). No letter N, legend or stated meaning.
